verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is a dependency-free C/C++ tool driven entirely from the command line. It runs as `llama cli` or as a headless `llama serve` server, ships as Docker images and pre-built release binaries, and can be built from source, all of which suit headless and CI automation. The evidence never describes CI pipelines or scripted, non-interactive runs, so headless/CI suitability is inferred from the packaging rather than shown. missing for 10: documented non-interactive/batch flags and exit-code behavior, CI pipeline examples or guidance, independent reports of running it in automated/CI pipelines.
